text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, saw inn landladies visiting 
Tracen Academy to promote hot springs, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Yunohana Bloom, from that "legendary 
Winning Live"...? Glad to see she's doing 
well.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Looks completely natural as young 
proprietress... Can't believe that much 
time passed since that "legendary Winning 
Live."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of Yunohana Bloom's singing, she 
performed traditional hot spring tread 
song with beautiful voice back at hot 
spring resort.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder what kind of quality her Winning 
Live had to be called "legendary"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Might serve as reference for <chrname>'s
lives. 
With that thought, searched archive for 
live footage—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now, please enjoy the performance! 
Yunohana Bloom-san singing —"Make debut!".
choice_data_list: Found it, this is the one!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Bwoeeeee~~♪

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Hogegheeehh♪

You found out, didn't you, Trainer-sama? 
That I am—

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Completely tone-deaf.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Goodness me, even so, to think those who 
remember back then still pass it down as 
'legendary in certain sense'!
choice_data_list: Even though you sang hot spring tr...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Strangely enough, that unique tempo 
matched me perfectly...
Only that one song 
comes out sounding nice♪
choice_data_list: Even though you're so good at the ...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Upbeat songs for Winning Lives, however, 
remained hopeless until retirement~.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Not at all.
Said that earlier just playing 
along. Doesn't bother me in least♪
choice_data_list: I'm sorry for watching the footage...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Even during active days, Keiko-san worked 
far harder trying to fix it than I ever 
did...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Devising vocal training methods,
gathering 
footage of helpful Winning Lives—

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Much like you right now, Trainer-sama.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Hey Yunohana, what're you chatting about 
over at Trainer-san's place?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu,
just discussing how 'Trainer-sama' 
always cares deeply for horse girls, 
across any era.
